subject: Preferred research cooldown rule for the Phase 2 dynamic pricing simulation

preferred_rule.description: 7 complete days must elapse after the previous simulated markdown window ends before a new markdown may start

retained_comparison.description: Original Phase 2 rule: 7-day cooldown counted between weekly decisions (never binds at weekly cadence)
retained_comparison.reproducibility: re-run inside the A1 evaluation and reproduced exactly in all 16 scenario x response runs

rationale: A1 meets the pre-frozen preference criteria (PA-PE), reduces downside losses under weak or no customer response, and reduces mandatory review workload. The reduced upside under stronger response is acknowledged and accepted for this research preference.
limitations: Synthetic data, assumed customer response, proxy prices and assumed costs
Only SC3 differs between rules (74 lines)
Exploratory: original results were seen before the A1 policy was frozen
unchanged: Pricing algorithms, evaluation thresholds, assumption sets v1-v8 and every protected output
